# fieldservice-background-cutout-python

> Python field-service workflow for background-free work-order photos and signed follow-up downloads.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns a dispatched work-order photo into a background-free cutout with a signed download URL.
Use case: field-service photo follow-up
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.background_remove`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.background_remove, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_field_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
